name: GoMate Mini
summary: GoMate Mini is VLUN Technology’s fourth-generation humanoid robot for security patrols and inspection. Its wheeled and articulated lower body supports movement through park and industrial environments, while two arms support interaction and handling. The manufacturer describes perception, path planning, anomaly recognition, task execution and reporting as an integrated workflow. GAC reports real commercial deployments in its August 2026 announcement.
